d:
Is sal ki shuruaat men 1 lakh 80 hazar rupye prati 10 gram tak pahunchne vale sone ki kimat pichhle kuchh haphton men giri hai. isi ka zikr karte hue pradhanmantri narendr modi ne ek karyakram men kaha ki unki apil par logon ne sona kharidna kam kar diya aur logon ne unki bat mani, aur ab sone ki kimat girne se in logon ko bara fayda huaa. lekin kya bharat men logon ne piem modi ki apil ke bad sach men sona kharidna band kar diya tha? jankar is bare men kya kahte hain?
Riport: chandan jajvare
